def transform(g, grow=None):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=0]
    rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ic=g[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]
    if grow is None:
        # outer frame thickness
        frame=[v for r,c,v in cells if v!=ic]
        # thickness = min distance from bbox edge to inner region
        inner=[(r,c) for r,c,v in cells if v==ic]
        ir0=min(r for r,c in inner); ic0=min(c for r,c in inner)
        grow=min(ir0-r0, ic0-c0)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-grow),min(h,r1+grow+1)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-grow),min(w,c1+grow+1)):
            out[r][c]=ic
    for r,c,v in cells:
        if v!=ic: out[r][c]=v
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=0]
    rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ic=g[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]
    grow=max(1,ic//2)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-grow),min(h,r1+grow+1)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-grow),min(w,c1+grow+1)):
            out[r][c]=ic
    for r,c,v in cells:
        if v!=ic: out[r][c]=v
    return out
assert transform(demo_in)==demo_out
